The Ring of Fire is a horseshoe-shaped zone around the edges of the Pacific Ocean that is known for its high levels of seismic activity, including frequent earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.

🌍 Countries Along the Ring of Fire:

North America: USA (California, Alaska), Canada, Mexico

South America: Chile, Peru, Ecuador

Asia: Japan, Indonesia, Philippines

Oceania: Papua New Guinea, New Zealand
